name: Five-colour sticky rice
summary: Five-colour sticky rice is Pì Pất or Ong glutinous rice colored with plants. One article names five colors. A later article names purple, green, and yellow. The plants and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Tay and Nung cooking on the Cao Bang roads, and a morning packet in town.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says the rice is colored with plants, in five colors, and that the same Pì Pất or Ong rice is also served as xôi and bánh giày. The 1 September 2026 article names purple, green, and yellow from natural leaves, a soft grain with the smell of upland sticky rice, eaten with crushed roasted peanut. It does not name five colors.
The plants are Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: In town as a morning packet on the 1 September 2026 article, and from the rice named on the 22 March 2023 route article. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Five-colour sticky rice in Cao Bang
seoDescription: Cao Bang five-colour sticky rice is colored with plants. One article says five colors. Another names purple, green, and yellow. A price is Check on arrival.
